notes.title: Update Delay Due to Typhoon Yagi
notes.notes:
Due to the impact of Typhoon Yagi, storms and floods have interrupted my progress on the game update. I appreciate your understanding and patience during this time. I'll resume work as soon as possible and keep you updated.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: v0.6.5 - Small Update
notes.notes:
Add Korean and Traditional Chinese languages,
Add a banish system that allows you to remove items from the store

notes.title: v0.4.6.1 - Apology for Recent Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Sorry everyone for the recent small updates. After updating to version 0.4.6, I received many bug reports, so I have been playing repeatedly to find and fix the issues. However, there are still some bugs I haven't been able to locate, such as the monster AI freezing. I will try to find the source of these bugs. Apologies for these updates.

notes.title: Early Access Release Announcement: Fight To The Death
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce that Fight To The Death is now available in Early Access!

What's Coming Next:
I am committed to continuously improving and expanding Fight To The Death. In the near future, expect even more characters, skills, and exciting new content to enhance your gaming experience.

notes.title: Fight To The Death Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings warriors!

We are thrilled to announce that Fight To The Death will officially launch on May 27th, 2024!

Early Access: The game will be released in early access, meaning you will have the opportunity to experience the game before the full version is complete. This is a great chance for you to participate in the development process, provide feedback, and help us create the best game possible

What to Expect in Early Access:


 8 Unique Characters: Choose from a roster of 8 diverse fighters, each with their own distinct fighting styles and abilities.
 1 Map: Battle it out on our first map, a visually stunning arena that will put your skills to the test.
 5 Difficulty Levels: Each level will get more and more difficult

Can't wait for you to join us in the arena!  Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to Fight To The Death!

#FightToTheDeath #EarlyAccess

notes.title: Announcement Regarding Release Demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce that the demo for Fight To The Death will be released in February!

Here are some details about the demo:


 Release Date: February (Specific date to be announced later)
 Content: Includes the first 12 levels of the game, 3 playable characters, and over 20 unique skills.
 Note: Save data from the demo will not be carried over to the full game.
 Some settings and options will be simplified compared to the full game.
 Despite these limitations, the demo is still a great opportunity for you to:


Get a better understanding of the game's mechanics.
Help us improve the game by providing feedback and suggestions.
Join our community to stay up-to-date on the latest news and developments:

 Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/FwUZSv34hB
